# Story Package: The Crucifixion (Gentle Version) – Matthew 27, Mark 15, Luke 23, John 19

**Story Key**: `crucifixionGentle`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Phase 6, Story #26 — Jesus gave His life because He loves us so much.

---

## Reverent Read-Aloud Retelling (for ages 3–8)

The soldiers took Jesus to a hill outside the city called Golgotha, which means “The Place of the Skull.” There they nailed His hands and feet to a wooden cross and lifted it up for everyone to see.

Above His head they put a sign that said, “This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.”

Many people stood around watching. Some said mean things. Others cried quietly. Jesus’ mother and some of His close friends stood nearby, their hearts breaking.

Even while He was in terrible pain, Jesus prayed, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”

One of the men hanging on a cross next to Jesus said, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom.”

Jesus answered him with love, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in paradise.”

Then Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “It is finished!” And He gave up His spirit.

The sky grew dark in the middle of the day. The earth shook. A Roman soldier who had been watching said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”

Jesus had done everything His Father asked. He had taken the punishment for our sins because He loves us so much. He gave His life so that we could be forgiven and be close to God forever.

## Coloring Page Prompt

Reverent but not scary black-and-white line art for ages 3–8. Three crosses on a hill. Jesus on the middle cross with a kind, peaceful face looking toward heaven. Two other men on the other crosses. A few people standing at a distance, some with heads bowed, one Roman soldier looking up in wonder. Soft clouds and a dark sky. Gentle, holy, and loving feeling. Clean bold lines with large open spaces.

---

## Read-Along Flow

Color the three crosses and the kind face of Jesus → listen to the story of how Jesus gave everything because He loves us → remember that “It is finished” means the way back to God is open for everyone who trusts in Him. This is the heart of the daily rhythm — we are loved and forgiven.

## Quiz — 4 Questions (with helpful scaffolding)

**1. What did Jesus pray while He was on the cross?**
- A) “Make these people go away”
- B) “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing”
- C) “I am too tired to stay here”
- D) “Why did You let this happen to Me?”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Jesus didn’t ask for the people to leave. Even in His pain, He asked God to forgive them.”
- If C: “He stayed until everything His Father asked was finished. He didn’t complain.”
- If D: “Jesus trusted His Father completely. His prayer was full of love and forgiveness.”

**2. What did Jesus say to the man on the cross next to Him who asked to be remembered?**
- A) “Maybe later”
- B) “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in paradise”
- C) “You have to be good first”
- D) “I don’t know you”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Jesus answered right away with love. He promised the man would be with Him that very day.”
- If C: “Jesus didn’t ask the man to do anything first. He welcomed him because of His great mercy.”
- If D: “Jesus knew the man’s heart. He gave him the most wonderful promise anyone could hear.”

**3. What did Jesus say just before He died?**
- A) “I am so angry”
- B) “It is finished!”
- C) “This hurts too much”
- D) “Where is everyone?”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Jesus wasn’t angry. He had finished everything His Father sent Him to do.”
- If C: “He did feel the pain, but His last words were about completing the work of love.”
- If D: “He knew exactly what was happening. ‘It is finished’ meant the way back to God was now open for us all.”

**4. What did one of the Roman soldiers say after seeing how Jesus died?**
- A) “This man was just like everyone else”
- B) “Surely this man was the Son of God!”
- C) “I don’t care what happened”
- D) “Let’s go home now”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “The way Jesus died — with love and forgiveness — showed the soldier that Jesus was different. He was the Son of God.”
- If C: “The soldier was deeply moved. He couldn’t stay the same after seeing Jesus.”
- If D: “What he saw changed him. He spoke the truth out loud: Jesus is the Son of God.”
